name: Squee
title: Goblin Nabob
role: Weatherlight cabin boy and survivor of Yawgmoth's resurrection curse
summary: An unlikely Weatherlight hero whose centuries of unwanted immortality ended with his choice of one final life during the renewed Phyrexian invasion.
biography: Squee joined the Weatherlight as an apparently insignificant goblin cabin boy and became a loyal member of its varied company.
During the original Phyrexian war, Yawgmoth's magic granted him a regenerative immortality that caused his body to be rebuilt after death.
The 2022 story Death and Salvation revealed that Ertai's compleation of Squee disrupted this cycle by separating his soul from the returning body.
Offered endless resurrection, final rest, or another choice, Squee asked Salvation to let him return for one last, finite life.
